## Read in basic files
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# Load the data
l10a_mono <- read_csv("PseudoU-L10A_monosome.csv")
l10a_di <- read_csv("PseudoU-L10A_disome.csv")

s17_mono <- read_csv("PseudoU-S17_monosome.csv")
s17_di <- read_csv("PseudoU-S17_disome.csv")

#very simple prep, just remove unecessary columns
prepANOVATime <- function(df){
  dfnum <- df[, c(1:7)]
}

pl10a_m <- prepANOVATime(l10a_mono)
pl10a_d <- prepANOVATime(l10a_di)

ps17_m <- prepANOVATime(s17_mono)
ps17_d <- prepANOVATime(s17_di)

#combine these so you can have comparisons across lsu and ssu pulldowns
monodf <- merge(pl10a_m, ps17_m, by = "Site", all.x = TRUE)
didf <- merge(pl10a_d, ps17_d, by = "Site", all.x = TRUE)

monodf
didf

```


# Running ANOVA across time for each fraction (mono, di)
```{r}
run_time_anova <- function(dfc, alpha = 0.05) {
  #get column names
  sample_cols <- colnames(dfc)[colnames(dfc) != "Site"]
  groups <- str_extract(sample_cols, "^[A-Za-z0-9]+-T[0-9]+") #extract groups including L10A and S17
  group_labels <- factor(groups) #factor treats the numbers (timepoints) as categorical

  # 2. Define ANOVA helper
  get_anova_stats <- function(y, g) {
    model <- lm(y ~ g)
    aov_table <- anova(model)
    F_stat <- aov_table$`F value`[1]
    p_val  <- aov_table$`Pr(>F)`[1]
    return(c(F_statistic = F_stat, p_value = p_val))
  }
  
  # 3. Run ANOVA row-wise
  sample_matrix <- dfc[, sample_cols] #can only apply on numeric cols
  
  anova_results <- t(apply(sample_matrix, 1, function(row) {
    get_anova_stats(as.numeric(row), group_labels)
  }))
  
  # 4. Build results table with q-values
  output <- data.frame(
    PseudoUSite = dfc$Site,
    F_statistic = anova_results[, "F_statistic"],
    p_value     = anova_results[, "p_value"]
  )
  
  qvals <- p.adjust(output$p_value, method = "BH")
  output$q_value <- qvals
  outputf <- output[order(output$q_value), ] #sort by smallest to largest q value
  
  dfnew <- dfc
  dfnew$q_value <- qvals
  dfnew <- dfnew %>% arrange(q_value)
  
  return(dfnew)
}

#monosome results
output_mono <- run_time_anova(monodf)
#disome results
output_di <- run_time_anova(didf)

output_mono
output_di

```

# Doing post hoc for the monodf and didf
```{r}
#This is just for the mono/di dataframes bc the group labels and the numeric columns
run_tukey <- function(df2, alpha = 0.05) {
  #This beginning part is to get group_labels and is right now very messy
  sample_cols <- colnames(df2)[colnames(df2) != "Site" & colnames(df2) != "q_value"]
  groups <- str_extract(sample_cols, "^[A-Za-z0-9]+-T[0-9]+") #extract groups including L10A and S17
  group_labels <- factor(groups) #factor treats the numbers (timepoints) as categorical
  
  tukey_list <- list()
  #loop through significant positions based on alpha
  sig_idx <- which(df2$q_value < alpha)

  for (i in sig_idx) {
    #gets just the numeric sample columns
    y <- as.numeric(df2[i, 2:13]) #remember to change this to just be the numeric non q-value columns
    model <- aov(y ~ group_labels) #fit model, note that this is redundant and not pretty but fix later
    tuk <- TukeyHSD(model) #run Tukey post_hoc
    tukey_list[[as.character(df2$Site[i])]] <- tuk #store with position label
  }
  return(tukey_list)
}

#run with a alpha of 1 so that you capture all Tukey's comparisons
posthoc_mono <- run_tukey(output_mono, 1)
posthoc_di <- run_tukey(output_di, 1)

posthoc_mono
posthoc_di
```

# Getting just the desired comparisons
```{r}

target_contrasts_monodi <- c(
  "L10A-T72-L10A-T0", 
  "S17-T72-S17-T0"
)

extract_tukey_pvals <- function(tukey_list, output, target_contrasts) {
  ftuk <- purrr::map_dfr(
    names(tukey_list),
    function(site) {

      tuk <- tukey_list[[site]][[1]]

      tuk_df <- as.data.frame(tuk)
      tuk_df$contrast <- rownames(tuk_df)
      tuk_df$site <- site

      tuk_df |>
        dplyr::filter(contrast %in% target_contrasts) |>
        dplyr::select(site, contrast, `p adj`)
    }
  )
  
  tukwide <- ftuk %>% pivot_wider(
    id_cols = site, 
    names_from = contrast,
    values_from = `p adj`
  )
  
  colname1 <- target_contrasts[1]
  colname2 <- target_contrasts[2]
    
  output$L10A_Time_Padj = tukwide[[colname1]]
  #output$L10A_Time_Padj = tukwide$`L10A_T72-L10A_T0`
  output$S17_Time_Padj = tukwide[[colname2]]
  #output$S17_Time_Padj = tukwide$`S17_T72-S17_T0`

  return(output)
}


p_output_mono <- extract_tukey_pvals(posthoc_mono, output_mono, target_contrasts_monodi)
p_output_di <- extract_tukey_pvals(posthoc_di, output_di, target_contrasts_monodi)

p_output_mono
p_output_di

```

# Writing all the output to folder - p adjusted output

These p-values are studentized p-values controlled for family-wise error rate from the Tukey's post hoc test.
Then the comparisons are from time 0 to 72 hours.

```{r}
#writing the output

write.csv(
  p_output_mono,
  file = "L10A_S17_Human_Pseudouridylations/Time_ANOVA/TukeyPAdj_Output/Mono_Output_TukeyPvals.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
) 

write.csv(
  p_output_di,
  file = "L10A_S17_Human_Pseudouridylations/Time_ANOVA/TukeyPAdj_Output/Di_Output_TukeyPvals.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
) 
```
